result.instructions: Tools for Customer Thermometer, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What is our NPS score for the last 30 days?"; "Show the red-rated survey comments from this month."; "How many gold responses did we get in October?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Customer Thermometer data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run customerthermometer_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run customerthermometer_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run customerthermometer_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. customerthermometer_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: customerthermometer_list_thermometers
tools.title: List Thermometers
tools.description: List the Thermometers (survey templates) in the account with their names and IDs. Returns XML. API: getThermometers.

tools.name: customerthermometer_list_recipient_lists
tools.title: List recipient lists
tools.description: List the recipient lists in the account with their names and IDs. Returns XML. API: getRecipientLists.

tools.name: customerthermometer_get_send_quota
tools.title: Get send quota
tools.description: Get the number of Thermometer credits left in the account. API: getSendQuota.

tools.name: customerthermometer_get_happiness_value
tools.title: Get Happiness Factor
tools.description: Get the Happiness Factor (a percentage) for the account, a Blast or a date range. Uses the newest 100 responses unless limit is set. API: getHappinessValue.

blastID.description: Limit to one Blast ID (in the URL of the Blast Breakdown page).

limit.description: Number of newest results to use.

tools.name: customerthermometer_get_nps_value
tools.title: Get NPS score
tools.description: Get the Net Promoter Score (an integer, can be negative) for the account, a Blast or a date range. limit only works together with blastID or a date range. API: getNPSValue.

blastID.description: Limit to one Blast ID (in the URL of the Blast Breakdown page).

limit.description: Number of newest results to use.

tools.name: customerthermometer_get_temperature_rating
tools.title: Get Temperature Rating
tools.description: Get the Temperature Rating (a percentage) for the account, a Blast or a date range. Uses the newest 100 responses unless limit is set. API: getTempRatingValue.

blastID.description: Limit to one Blast ID (in the URL of the Blast Breakdown page).

limit.description: Number of newest results to use.

tools.name: customerthermometer_get_response_rate
tools.title: Get response rate
tools.description: Get the response rate (a percentage) of Email Thermometer Blasts for the account, a Blast or a date range. Uses the newest 100 responses unless limit is set. API: getResponseRateValue.

blastID.description: Limit to one Blast ID (in the URL of the Blast Breakdown page).

limit.description: Number of newest results to use.

tools.name: customerthermometer_count_responses
tools.title: Count responses
tools.description: Count the responses for the account, a Blast, a date range or one temperature (1 gold, 2 green, 3 yellow, 4 red). API: getNumResponsesValue.

blastID.description: Limit to one Blast ID (in the URL of the Blast Breakdown page).

limit.description: Number of newest results to use.

tools.name: customerthermometer_get_blast_results
tools.title: Get survey responses
tools.description: Get the newest survey responses (default 200) with all attached data, as XML. Filter by temperature, Blast or date range. The data holds respondent personal data. API: getBlastResults.

blastID.description: Limit to one Blast ID (in the URL of the Blast Breakdown page).

tools.name: customerthermometer_get_comments
tools.title: Get response comments
tools.description: Get the newest free-text comments (default 200) left with survey responses, as XML. Filter by temperature, Blast or date range. API: getComments.

blastID.description: Limit to one Blast ID (in the URL of the Blast Breakdown page).
